sentences.text: Case taken up before the Lawazima Court.
None appears on behalf of the petitioner.
Perusal of the office note dated 18.03.2025 reveals that notice was issued to the respondent No. 5 by registered post with A/D on 16.03.2024.
However, in regard to the notice issued to the respondent No. 5, it appears that the said notice has been received un-served with the following postal remark "Not found Return to sender".
In view of the above, the petitioner is directed to obtain proper instructions regarding the address of the respondent No. 5, within 7 (seven) days from the date of this order.
Let the matter be listed again before the Lawazima Court on 24.03.2025.
